newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: South Africa group launches Mauritius reinsurance.
newsitem.headline: South Africa group launches Mauritius reinsurance.

text.p: South African Forbes Group on Monday launched P.F (Mauritius) Limited, the first specialised reinsurance broking company on the island, company officials said.

They said Forbes, among the top 15 insurance brokers in the world, would use Mauritius as a springboard for the South African Group's overseas reinsurance operations, targeting the Indian Ocean islands, the Indian sub-continent and East Africa.

"We chose Mauritius because it has a well-established insurance market and the relaxed exchange control regulations facilitate business," said Phil Pettersen, managing director of Forbes Reinsurance Broking Services (Forbes Re).
Exchange controls in Mauritius were suspended in July 1994.
Forbes Re opened a branch in Mauritius late last year but for its best long-term interests the group decided to turn the branch into a fully-fledged company with local partners, the statement said.
Subject to Mauritian government approval, Forbes will hold 74 percent in P.F (Mauritius) Limited and the remaining 26 percent will be held by Mauritian businessman Guy Lagesse.
